resources.string: Use one unaccented Pinyin syllable per character, separated by spaces or apostrophes. ü, u: and v are accepted. Switch to English input to type the reading if needed.
Check the Chinese word and provide one valid Pinyin syllable per character. Separate ambiguous syllables with spaces.

Import or export through Languages → Added Words. UTF-8 text, one reading per line: Chinese word, a TAB, 462106, a TAB, Pinyin. Example: 重庆[TAB]462106[TAB]chong qing. Multiple pronunciations use separate lines. Existing word-and-language files remain supported.
No matching user words. Add a word or import through Languages.
